_meta.purpose: Design-document scenarios that no test claims, and why.

kinds.visual: Cannot be verified headlessly. Needs a stated reason and the committed capture that covers it, or the milestone that will produce one.
kinds.deferred: Not yet due. Needs the milestone that owns it.

_meta.the_other_kind: A scenario VERIFIED by a test is not listed here. Its claim lives beside the test, as a '# @covers <Feature> / <Scenario>' line, so it moves with the code it describes.
_meta.matching: Feature and scenario text are quoted from the design document VERBATIM. check_spec_coverage.py requires a bijection, so rewording a heading in the document breaks every claim on it — deliberately. A fuzzy match would absorb the rename silently, which is the failure the gate exists to prevent.
_meta.honesty: The gate can check that every scenario is claimed and that a deferral names a milestone. It CANNOT check that a deferred scenario really belongs to the milestone named, nor that a verified claim's test really tests that scenario. Those are review's job — see design D4 of add-determinism-and-coverage-harness.

entries.reason: Requires seeing that grass is still visible beyond the kart and that no wall or ground edge is drawn. Nothing about that is measurable from state.
entries.note: Met by A11's settlement (add-render-pipeline-and-web-budget): a ground skirt in the Ground's own albedo spans past fogEnd, so from the pinned boundary the chase camera sees grass dissolving into fog with no drawn edge — the capture shows it, and world_test asserts the geometry that guarantees it (nearest skirt edge beyond fogEnd from anywhere drivable). The specified 200x200 Ground, the +/-90 boundary, and 50-150 fog are untouched. Earlier notes and the elevated-oblique capture remain in git history.

entries.reason: HALF DONE, and deferred until the other half exists. add-audio-cue-core put the stream in sim.stats_line(), so the headless half — byte-identical ids, order, tick timestamps and volumes across runs — is now tested: tests/audio_cue_test.gd replays the baked lap script twice and compares the whole stream byte for byte, and determinism_test, replay_test and conformance item 14 all fail on a cue-only divergence (mutation-verified). What is NOT tested is ACROSS RENDER RATES, which is the scenario's other clause and acceptance item 16's: that needs tools/refresh_probe.gd to record the stream at 30/60/144 fps, and the probe extension belongs to add-audio-playback. A partial claim is not a claim, so this stays deferred rather than being claimed by the suite that covers half of it.
entries.note: Entered the universe when amend-gdd-for-audio-cues was applied (owner-approved 2026-09-04). Owed by the M10 implementation changes; add-audio-cue-core took the headless half, add-audio-playback owes the cross-rate half and with it the claim.
